name: baguette-review
description: Use Baguette CX Review Mode from Codex, retrieve review annotations through MCP, and scaffold project-local apply skills.

interface.shortDescription: Open Baguette CX Mode and retrieve structured UI review annotations
interface.longDescription: Use Baguette Review to start or reuse a local Baguette server, open an iOS simulator review URL in the Codex browser, wait for human CX Mode comments, and retrieve annotation JSON for project-side implementation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start or reuse Baguette, choose the booted iPhone 17 Pro or first booted simulator, open its Baguette CX Review URL in the Codex in-app browser, and wait for review annotations
